hypothesis: Enabling system+tools prompt caching for the reproduce and fix phases reduces input tokens materially with no verified-fix-rate regression.
designRationale: Same tasks and seeds under baseline (cache off) and candidate (cache on); paired reduces variance from task difficulty.
multipleComparisonPolicy: single pre-registered comparison (cache on vs off); no sweep, so no correction required
invalidTrialPolicy: infrastructure_failed and timeout trials are excluded and reported; a task with >1/3 invalid trials is re-run once, then flagged
